description: This file defines the Request class in the Slim Framework's PSR-7 implementation, representing an HTTP server request with methods for accessing request data, headers, URI, method, body, and other HTTP request specifics.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP server request, implementing PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface, with properties for method, URI, headers, cookies, server parameters, body, uploaded files, and attributes. Provides methods for accessing and modifying request data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Request object with method, URI, headers, cookies, server parameters, body, and uploaded files.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Performs deep copying of headers and body upon cloning the Request object.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new request with the specified HTTP method.

methods.name: filterMethod
methods.description: Validates and filters the HTTP method string.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns the request target, defaulting to path and query from the URI.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new request with the specified request target.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI object of the request.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new request with the specified URI, optionally preserving the host header.

methods.name: getCookieParams
methods.description: Returns the cookies associated with the request.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Returns a new request with the specified cookie parameters.

methods.name: getQueryParams
methods.description: Returns the query parameters as an array, parsing from the URI if necessary.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Returns a new request with the specified query parameters.

methods.name: getUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns the array of uploaded files.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns a new request with the specified uploaded files.

methods.name: getServerParams
methods.description: Returns the server parameters array.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes set in the request.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Returns a specific attribute by name, with a default fallback.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new request with an added attribute.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new request without the specified attribute.

methods.name: getParsedBody
methods.description: Returns the parsed body content, if any.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Returns a new request with the specified parsed body content.

search-terms: Request constructor with URI and headers
